# /crav1-ado-to-specs

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From Azure Boards to specs](../../from-ado-to-specs.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-ado-to-specs/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Read Azure Boards Features that the specs already record.

Reads Azure Boards Features back and shows what differs. A kept change goes through [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md). A reply comment is posted only after a yes.

Each id is read in its own work item home. An id not found there is reported as moved or missing, and it asks before searching other projects.

## Runs when

Read Azure Boards Features back. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: Recorded Feature ids, or the ids named.

Reads the ids in every `work-item.md` and the landscape “No spec yet in ADO” table, or only the ids the user names, then State, Priority, Target Date, Iteration, Assigned To, discussion comments, and history. It reads the checks from Acceptance Criteria when the Feature type has that field, and from the Acceptance checks list in the Description when it does not, so a match is not a change. Comments use api version `7.1-preview`, which `az devops invoke` can parse.

## Writes

In short: Nothing itself. A reply comment in Azure Boards only after a yes. Kept changes and answers go to the spec through [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md).

Writes nothing itself. A kept change and an answer the user gives go to the spec through [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md). A reply comment is posted only after the user says yes.

## Does not

Leaves a missing id unmatched.

Limits and exceptions: dismissals start fresh each run. A no-spec-yet Feature names a starter such as [`/crav1-spark-to-spec`](crav1-spark-to-spec.md) and does not run it. When the spec has no answer, no reply is drafted and the question is offered as an open question. An `az` failure, including a failed field read, is handled the same way as [`/crav1-specs-to-ado`](crav1-specs-to-ado.md). It does not start Specify, Plan, or Build. It is not a starter option.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md) for one kept change and for one answer.
